description: Auto-merge for patch+minor (stable, >=1.0.0, 3-day age) is enabled fleet-wide from the global config; gitops/* repos are auto-patch only (minor stays a reviewed MR). No per-repo preset needed.

packageRules.description: Do NOT bump the legacy in-guest agent's Go version. It cross-compiles to a windows/386 exe that must run on Windows XP, and only the Go 1.10.x toolchain still stamps PE MinSubsystemVersion 4.0 — every Go >= 1.11 stamps 6.1 and XP's loader rejects the binary outright ('Exec format error', verified on a real XP guest). go/build.sh asserts this and fails the build, so a bumped toolchain does not silently ship a dud; it just makes the agent unbuildable. See conservation/guest_agent/README.md.

The Python floor stays at ^3.11 — the version vmctl-core requires — not whatever is newest. This controller is installed onto exhibition machines whose OS is chosen by what the artwork needs, not by what upstream Python supports; raising the floor to a just-released interpreter would strand a gallery host that ships an older one. CI runs the newest Python regardless, so we still learn about breakage early.
